purpose: Conditional manufactured action of the private CPU closed-top gradient substitution; not a mechanical trajectory, measured face flux, conservation or stability proof.

dependency.use: One renamed main/one AppInfo; neutral declarations only. Do not invoke its wave reader or retained main. Existing project headers and libraries, no new library.

TopKernelBand q0=10000/ramp.01 and drainage start.01 retained, but audit stays t0 with load0/drain closed. No viscosity/HG/SPR/damping/DDT/Shifting/Shepard/softening.
input.binding: Future build/caller must bind exact input XML/BI4/Normals, current source/objects/program/runtime and owned exit. CPP does not make independent SHA/owned-call claims.

lifecycle: Set the four private flags before actual LoadConfig->LoadCaseParticles->VisuConfig->ConfigDomain->ConfigRunMode->InitRunCpu->FreePartsInit->RunCellDivide(true). One real Interaction_Forces(SymPredictor) at natural rest must yield strict soil Ace/theta/pdot0, actual C and initial10 top FSType2/3. All manufactured complete-rate calls occur before PosInteraction_Forces releases live scratch. No Run/ComputeStep/PreCorr/SaveData, no time or history advance.

wall_and_periodic: Manufacture p/J1/theta0 explicitly at actual fluid slots, including X images (same z); this is an input assignment, not a pressure-copy proof. Invoke actual wall-state MLS and wall-C reconstruction, never hand-write bottom p/J/sigma/Ace. Assign Ace only normal soil owners; each real complete-rate call performs its production periodic Ace/theta extension, wall acceleration reconstruction and rate extension. Verify periodic fluid J/C/Ace/theta/rate owner bytes; no claim about uninitialized ghost plastic/load fields.

reference.support: Independent O(Np^2) all-slot loop for all1000 normal soil receivers, actual double positions, support/ALMOSTZERO, float Wendland factor, current actual C and same-stage wall fields. No production neighbor table, fitted support or analytic bottom replacement.
reference.formula: Vj=(MassFluid/rho0)*Jj; w=Vj*d dot((Ci+Cj)gradW)/(r2+Eta2); Lp=sum(w*(pi-pj)); lx=sum(w*d); gp=-sum(Vj*(pi-pj)*Ci gradW); DA=sum(Vj*(Aj-Ai) dot Ci gradW). For actual surface mask, r=N dot(gp+rho_w Ai)/(N dot N), gpcorr=gp-N*r. New=B[-theta+k/gamma*(Lp-gpcorr dot lx+rho_w DA)], old uses gp. B=Kw/n(J), gamma=rho_w*9.80665.
reference.budget: For every row keep the prior64*FLT_EPS raw absolute-term envelope +256*DBL_EPS*max(1,abs(B*theta))+1e-6 Pa/s. Absolute gp propagation includes projection: agpcorr=agp+abs(N)*[abs(N) dot(agp+rho_w abs(Ai))/(N dot N)]. Do not shrink the raw bound on a zero-result field. Old action retains its own unprojected raw budget.
reference.gates: All actual rates finite and within new raw budget of independent reference. Correction identity new-old=B*k/gamma*r*(N dot lx) uses combined old/new raw envelope. Upper500 soil z>.5 require independently assembled ideal gp; compatible/tangential rates and unmasked old action agree within original budgets. Actual bottom remains a conditional reference check only; no global affine/bottom-zero claim.
reference.invariance: Invoke actual completeRate with native soil FSNormal factors1,-1,+2. Compare actual rates using max(original baseline budget,current budget), not a new0ULP requirement. Each incompatible variant requires its maximum actual-old correction ratio>100 using max(new budget,old budget). Constructed projected normal-gradient0 is only algebraic, not observed face q_n.
reference.norm_guard: Reuse the already passed last positive tangential/scale2 state. Change just one actual top normal to0, then NaN, in separate restored probes. Accept only JException with method ::ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateCpu) and exact declared nonfinite-rate/conductivity-gradient message; any other exception propagates. No positive result is inferred from arbitrary throws.

rollback: Capture original live state after the natural real force. memcpy snapshots cover current Np Pos/Code/ID/Dcell/Vel/sigma/p/p0/rate/J/theta/C/FSType/FSNormal/loadAce/Ace/Arc/Rsigma/BoundDerivativeVel/TangenVel/BoundMode, plus conductivity-speed cache. Restore exact bytes between fields and guard probes and finally before PosInteraction_Forces; check unchanged time/Nstep/locked dt/LastDt/FixedDt error/no predictor histories. This is a named-block claim, not whole-object/pool/statistics byte identity. Raw unused scratch object bytes may be preserved but are not numerically interpreted.
fresh_protection: Input must exist; output directory must not. Failure retains partial output. No automatic rerun or downstream admission.
held: No active drainage event/Dirichlet opening or nonzero top-load force-stage audit at t0
No saturated-domain or elastic/RH guards bypassed; no alternate constitutive law
No actual discrete face flux, pair conservation, full stability or formal-case acceptance
No variable-k loaded column/public/GPU/3D/general wall admission
Original coarse and dt-only half failures remain false and untouched
